show.description: Amit, a self-respecting society guard, falls in love with Priya, a wealthy businessman’s daughter, after she stands up for his dignity. Their love is tested when Priya’s father humiliates Amit and challenges him to earn one crore on his own to prove his worth. Forced apart by manipulation and sacrifice, Amit begins a brutal journey through humiliation, ambition, and heartbreak, determined to rise against class barriers and reclaim both his love and his self-respect.
